subject: Graduate Civil Engineer, Sydney, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Kenneth,

I saw your SEEK listing for Graduate Civil Engineer roles in Sydney (job 94951825) and am writing to you directly as the advert asks applicants to email kenneth@crau.com.au.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney for a graduate or junior site and estimating path. I have under 12 months site experience and no Australian civil employment yet, which the advert's 6 to 12 months desired experience notes as preferred rather than essential.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Graduate Civil Engineer, Sydney
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer roles you listed on SEEK (94951825) for a Sydney civil client, covering site engineering and junior estimating on earthworks, remediation and general civil projects.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with Australian Standards and Austroads guides. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared progress reports.

I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to relocating to Sydney. I do not yet have Australian civil employment.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I am available for an interview now.
